title: Cloud sessions run the full ritmofit-web gate, and a saved cloud environment sets them up
acceptance: In a claude.ai/code cloud session on this repo, every command in AGENTS.md › Verification, PRs, And Commits passes from a fresh clone, including pnpm --filter @ritmofit/e2e e2e, with wall times recorded here.

A personal cloud environment for this repo holds a setup script made only of commands that session ran (install, .dev.vars from the example, local D1 migrate and seed, any Playwright step), and its name is recorded here; no secret is stored in it.
nextAction: Owner chose cloud sessions for web builders on 2026-11-24 (RF-248). Start a cloud session on steven-crosby/ritmofit-web, run the gate, propose the environment; nothing is committed from that session except this record's evidence in a records PR.
